record.bible_text: And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Speak<WH01696><WTH8761> unto Aaron<WH0175> and to his sons<WH01121>, that they separate<WH05144><WTH8735> themselves from the holy things<WH06944> of the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, and that they profane<WH02490><WTH8762> not my holy<WH06944> name<WH08034> <FI>in those things<Fi> which they hallow<WH06942><WTH8688> unto me: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.

Say<WH0559><WTH8798> unto them, Whosoever<WH0376> <FI>he be<Fi> of all your seed<WH02233> among your generations<WH01755>, that goeth<WH07126><WTH8799> unto the holy things<WH06944>, which the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> hallow<WH06942><WTH8686> unto the LORD<WH03068>, having his uncleanness<WH02932> upon him, that soul<WH05315> shall be cut off<WH03772><WTH8738> from my presence<WH06440>: I <FI>am<Fi>  the LORD<WH03068>.

What man soever<WH0376> of the seed<WH02233> of Aaron<WH0175> <FI>is<Fi> a leper<WH06879><WTH8803>, or hath a running issue<WH02100><WTH8802>; he shall not eat<WH0398><WTH8799> of the holy things<WH06944>, until he be clean<WH02891><WTH8799>. And whoso toucheth<WH05060><WTH8802> any thing <FI>that is<Fi> unclean<WH02931> <FI>by<Fi> the dead<WH05315>, or a man<WH0376> whose seed<WH02233><WH07902> goeth<WH03318><WTH8799> from him; <RF>running...: Heb. running of the reins<Rf>

Or whosoever<WH0376> toucheth<WH05060><WTH8799> any creeping thing<WH08318>, whereby he may be made unclean<WH02930><WTH8799>, or a man<WH0120> of whom he may take uncleanness<WH02930><WTH8799>, whatsoever uncleanness<WH02932> he hath;

The soul<WH05315> which hath touched<WH05060><WTH8799> any such shall be unclean<WH02930><WTH8804> until even<WH06153>, and shall not eat<WH0398><WTH8799> of the holy things<WH06944>, unless<WH0518> he wash<WH07364><WTH8804> his flesh<WH01320> with water<WH04325>.

And when the sun<WH08121> is down<WH0935><WTH8804>, he shall be clean<WH02891><WTH8804>, and shall afterward<WH0310> eat<WH0398><WTH8799> of the holy things<WH06944>; because it <FI>is<Fi> his food<WH03899>.
That which dieth of itself<WH05038>, or is torn<WH02966> <FI>with beasts<Fi> , he shall not eat<WH0398><WTH8799> to defile<WH02930><WTH8800> himself therewith: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.

They shall therefore keep<WH08104><WTH8804> mine ordinance<WH04931>, lest they bear<WH05375><WTH8799> sin<WH02399> for it, and die<WH04191><WTH8804> therefore, if they profane<WH02490><WTH8762> it: I the LORD<WH03068> do sanctify<WH06942><WTH8764> them.<CM>

There shall no stranger<WH02114><WTH8801> eat<WH0398><WTH8799> <FI>of<Fi> the holy thing<WH06944>: a sojourner<WH08453> of the priest<WH03548>, or an hired servant<WH07916>, shall not eat<WH0398><WTH8799> <FI>of<Fi> the holy thing<WH06944>.

But if the priest<WH03548> buy<WH07069><WTH8799> <FI>any<Fi> soul<WH05315> with<WH07075> his money<WH03701>, he shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> of it, and he that is born<WH03211> in his house<WH01004>: they shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> of his meat<WH03899>. <RF>with...: Heb. with the purchase of his money<Rf>

If the priest's<WH03548> daughter<WH01323> also be <FI>married<Fi> unto a stranger<WH0376><WH02114><WTH8801>, she may not eat<WH0398><WTH8799> of an offering<WH08641> of the holy things<WH06944>. <RF>a stranger: Heb. a man a stranger<Rf>

But if the priest's<WH03548> daughter<WH01323> be a widow<WH0490>, or divorced<WH01644><WTH8803>, and have no child<WH02233>, and is returned<WH07725><WTH8804> unto her father's<WH01> house<WH01004>, as in her youth<WH05271>, she shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> of her father's<WH01> meat<WH03899>: but there shall no stranger<WH02114><WTH8801> eat<WH0398><WTH8799> thereof.

And if a man<WH0376> eat<WH0398><WTH8799> <FI>of<Fi> the holy thing<WH06944> unwittingly<WH07684>, then he shall put<WH03254><WTH8804> the fifth<WH02549> <FI>part<Fi> thereof unto it, and shall give<WH05414><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> unto the priest<WH03548> with the holy thing<WH06944>.
And they shall not profane<WH02490><WTH8762> the holy things<WH06944> of the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, which they offer<WH07311><WTH8686> unto the LORD<WH03068>;

Or suffer them to bear<WH05375><WTH8689> the iniquity<WH05771> of trespass<WH0819>, when they eat<WH0398><WTH8800> their holy things<WH06944>: for I the LORD<WH03068> do sanctify<WH06942><WTH8764> them. <RF>suffer...: or, lade themselves with the iniquity of trespass in their eating<Rf><CM>
And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Speak<WH01696><WTH8761> unto Aaron<WH0175>, and to his sons<WH01121>, and unto all the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, and say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto them, Whatsoever<WH0376> <FI>he be<Fi> of the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478>, or of the strangers<WH01616> in Israel<WH03478>, that will offer<WH07126><WTH8686> his oblation<WH07133> for all his vows<WH05088>, and for all his freewill offerings<WH05071>, which they will offer<WH07126><WTH8686> unto the LORD<WH03068> for a burnt offering<WH05930>;
<FI> Ye shall offer<Fi> at your own will<WH07522> a male<WH02145> without blemish<WH08549>, of the beeves<WH01241>, of the sheep<WH03775>, or of the goats<WH05795>.
<FI> But<Fi> whatsoever hath a blemish<WH03971>, <FI>that<Fi> shall ye not offer<WH07126><WTH8686>: for it shall not be acceptable<WH07522> for you.

And whosoever<WH0376> offereth<WH07126><WTH8686> a sacrifice<WH02077> of peace offerings<WH08002> unto the LORD<WH03068> to accomplish<WH06381><WTH8763> <FI>his<Fi> vow<WH05088>, or a freewill offering<WH05071> in beeves<WH01241> or sheep<WH06629>, it shall be perfect<WH08549> to be accepted<WH07522>; there shall be no blemish<WH03971> therein. <RF>sheep: or, goats<Rf>

Blind<WH05788>, or broken<WH07665><WTH8803>, or maimed<WH02782><WTH8803>, or having a wen<WH02990>, or scurvy<WH01618>, or scabbed<WH03217>, ye shall not offer<WH07126><WTH8686> these unto the LORD<WH03068>, nor make<WH05414><WTH8799> an offering by fire<WH0801> of them upon the altar<WH04196> unto the LORD<WH03068>.

Either a bullock<WH07794> or a lamb<WH07716> that hath any thing superfluous<WH08311><WTH8803> or lacking in his parts<WH07038><WTH8803>, that mayest thou offer<WH06213><WTH8799> <FI>for<Fi> a freewill offering<WH05071>; but for a vow<WH05088> it shall not be accepted<WH07521><WTH8735>. <RF>lamb: or, kid<Rf>

Ye shall not offer<WH07126><WTH8686> unto the LORD<WH03068> that which is bruised<WH04600><WTH8803>, or crushed<WH03807><WTH8803>, or broken<WH05423><WTH8803>, or cut<WH03772><WTH8803>; neither shall ye make<WH06213><WTH8799> <FI>any offering thereof<Fi>  in your land<WH0776>.

Neither from a stranger's<WH05236> hand<WH03027><WH01121> shall ye offer<WH07126><WTH8686> the bread<WH03899> of your God<WH0430> of any of these; because their corruption<WH04893> <FI>is<Fi> in them, <FI>and<Fi> blemishes<WH03971> <FI>be<Fi> in them: they shall not be accepted<WH07521><WTH8735> for you.
And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

When a bullock<WH07794>, or a sheep<WH03775>, or a goat<WH05795>, is brought forth<WH03205><WTH8735>, then it shall be seven<WH07651> days<WH03117> under the dam<WH0517>; and from the eighth<WH08066> day<WH03117> and thenceforth<WH01973> it shall be accepted<WH07521><WTH8735> for an offering<WH07133> made by fire<WH0801> unto the LORD<WH03068>.
And <FI>whether it be<Fi> cow<WH07794> or ewe<WH07716>, ye shall not kill<WH07819><WTH8799> it and her young<WH01121> both in one<WH0259> day<WH03117>. <RF>ewe: or, she goat<Rf>
And when ye will offer<WH02076><WTH8799> a sacrifice<WH02077> of thanksgiving<WH08426> unto the LORD<WH03068>, offer<WH02076><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> at your own will<WH07522>.
On the same day<WH03117> it shall be eaten up<WH0398><WTH8735>; ye shall leave<WH03498><WTH8686> none of it until the morrow<WH01242>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.
Therefore shall ye keep<WH08104><WTH8804> my commandments<WH04687>, and do<WH06213><WTH8804> them: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.

Neither shall ye profane<WH02490><WTH8762> my holy<WH06944> name<WH08034>; but I will be hallowed<WH06942><WTH8738> among<WH08432> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> which hallow<WH06942><WTH8762> you,
That brought you out<WH03318><WTH8688> of the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>, to be your God<WH0430>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>
